parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.label: Subscriptions
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| where properties.state =~ 'Enabled'
| project value = id, label = name, selected = true
| order by label asc
parameters.description: Subscriptions to scan for previous-generation VM exposure.

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
    or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'
| summarize Resources = count() by resourceGroup
| project value = resourceGroup, label = strcat(resourceGroup, ' (', Resources, ')'), selected = false
| order by label asc
parameters.description: Limit results to selected resource groups.

parameters.name: Regions
parameters.label: Regions
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
    or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'
| summarize Resources = count() by location
| project value = location, label = strcat(location, ' (', Resources, ')'), selected = false
| order by label asc
parameters.description: Limit results to selected Azure regions.

parameters.name: ComputeInventoryQuery
parameters.value:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
    or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'
| extend
    ResourceKind = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'VM', 'VMSS'),
    TargetId = tolower(id),
    VmSize = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), tostring(sku.name)),
    CurrentCapacity = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 1, coalesce(toint(sku.capacity), 0)),
    OperatingSystem = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType), ''),
    Priority = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', tostring(properties.priority), ''),
    AvailabilitySet = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', extract('/availabilitySets/([^/]+)$', 1, tostring(properties.availabilitySet.id)), ''),
    EphemeralOS = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.diffDiskSettings.option) =~ 'Local', false),
    OrchestrationMode = tostring(properties.orchestrationMode),
    UpgradeMode = tostring(properties.upgradePolicy.mode),
    Zones = strcat_array(zones, ', ')
| extend _sizeKey = toupper(VmSize), _loc = tolower(location)
| extend Series = case(
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_F[0-9]+S_V2$', 'Fsv2',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_FS[0-9]+_V2$', 'Fsv2',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_FS[0-9]+$', 'Fs',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_F[0-9]+[A-Z]*S$', 'Fs',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_F[0-9]+$', 'F',

    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_D[0-9]+I?S_V3$', 'Dsv3',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_D[0-9]+I?_V3$', 'Dv3',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_DS[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?_V2$', 'Dsv2',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_D[0-9]+I?S_V2$', 'Dsv2',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_D[0-9]+I?_V2$', 'Dv2',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_DS[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?$', 'Ds',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_D[0-9]+S$', 'Ds',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_D[0-9]+$', 'D',

    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_B[0-9]+[A-Z]*S$', 'Bs',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_B[0-9]+[A-Z]*$', 'B',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_A[0-9]+M_V2$', 'Amv2',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_A[0-9]+_V2$', 'Av2',

    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_E[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?I?S_V3$', 'Esv3',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_E[0-9]+I?_V3$', 'Ev3',

    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_GS[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?$', 'Gs',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_G[0-9]+S$', 'Gs',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_G[0-9]+$', 'G',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_L[0-9]+S_V2$', 'Lsv2',
    _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_L[0-9]+S$', 'Ls',
    '')
| extend Category = case(
    Series in ('F','Fs','Fsv2'), 'Compute optimized',
    Series in ('D','Ds','Dv2','Dsv2','Dv3','Dsv3','B','Bs','Av2','Amv2'), 'General purpose',
    Series in ('Ev3','Esv3','G','Gs'), 'Memory optimized',
    Series in ('Ls','Lsv2'), 'Storage optimized',
    '')
| extend
    _sovereign = _loc matches regex '^(usgov|usdod|usnat|ussec|china)',
    _npHc = _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_(NP[0-9]+S|HC[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?RS)$',
    _v7Excluded = _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_(D[0-9]+I?(S|DS|LS|LDS)|E[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?I?(S|DS))_V7$',
    _regionalPct = case(
        _loc == 'northeurope', 17,
        _loc in ('francecentral','francesouth'), 11,
        _loc in ('westeurope','norwayeast','norwaywest'), 9,
        _loc == 'southeastasia', 8,
        0)
| extend _v1v2 = _npHc or Series in ('D','Ds','Dv2','Dsv2','Ls','Av2','Amv2','B','Bs','F','Fs','Fsv2','G','Gs','Lsv2')
| extend RetirementDate = case(
    Series in ('D','Ds','Dv2','Dsv2','Ls'), datetime(2028-05-01),
    Series in ('Av2','Amv2','B','Bs','F','Fs','Fsv2','G','Gs','Lsv2'), datetime(2028-11-15),
    Series in ('Dv3','Dsv3','Ev3','Esv3') and not(_sovereign), datetime(2029-11-15),
    _npHc, datetime(2027-05-31),
    todatetime(''))
| extend LifecycleStatus = case(
    isempty(Series), '',
    isnotnull(RetirementDate), 'Capacity restricted + retirement scheduled',
    'Capacity restricted; product active')
| extend RecommendedTarget = case(
    Series in ('D','Ds','Dv2','Dsv2','Dv3','Dsv3'), 'Dv5/Dsv5, Dv6/Dsv6, or Dv7/Dsv7',
    Series in ('Ev3','Esv3'), 'Ev5/Esv5, Esv6, or Esv7',
    Series in ('Av2','Amv2'), 'Bsv2/Basv2 or D/E v5-v6',
    Series in ('B','Bs'), 'Bsv2/Basv2 or Dlsv5-v6',
    Series in ('F','Fs','Fsv2'), 'Dlsv5-v6, Dsv5, or Falsv6',
    Series in ('G','Gs'), 'Lsv3/Lasv3 or Lsv4/Lasv4',
    Series in ('Ls','Lsv2'), 'Lsv3/Lasv3 or Lsv4/Lasv4',
    '')
| extend PriceChangePct = case(isempty(_sizeKey) or _sovereign, 0, _v1v2, 25, _v7Excluded, 0, _regionalPct)
| extend PriceChange = case(
    isempty(_sizeKey), 'Unknown size',
    _sovereign, 'None (sovereign cloud)',
    _v1v2, '+25% (v1/v2 series)',
    _regionalPct > 0 and _v7Excluded, 'None (excluded v7 series)',
    _regionalPct > 0, strcat('+', tostring(_regionalPct), '% regional'),
    'None announced')
| extend SizeVersion = iff(_sizeKey matches regex '_V[0-9]+$', strcat('v', extract('_V([0-9]+)$', 1, _sizeKey)), 'v1')
| project-away _sizeKey, _loc, _sovereign, _npHc, _v7Excluded, _regionalPct, _v1v2
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/autoscalesettings'
    | mv-expand Profile = properties.profiles
    | extend
        TargetId = tolower(tostring(properties.targetResourceUri)),
        ProfileMin = toint(Profile.capacity.minimum),
        ProfileMax = toint(Profile.capacity.maximum)
    | summarize AutoscaleMin = min(ProfileMin), AutoscaleMax = max(ProfileMax), AutoscaleProfiles = count() by TargetId
  ) on TargetId
| extend
    AutoscaleMin = iff(ResourceKind == 'VM', 1, coalesce(AutoscaleMin, CurrentCapacity)),
    AutoscaleMax = iff(ResourceKind == 'VM', 1, coalesce(AutoscaleMax, CurrentCapacity))
| extend GrowthGap = iff(isnotempty(Series) and AutoscaleMax > CurrentCapacity, AutoscaleMax - CurrentCapacity, 0)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
| extend
    InstanceCount = CurrentCapacity,
    Risk = case(isempty(Series), '', ResourceKind == 'VMSS' and GrowthGap > 0, 'Critical', RetirementDate < datetime(2029-01-01), 'High', 'Medium'),
    MigrationConsiderations = strcat_array(array_concat(
        iff(ResourceKind == 'VM' and isnotempty(AvailabilitySet), pack_array('Coordinate availability-set migration'), dynamic([])),
        iff(ResourceKind == 'VM' and isnotempty(Zones), pack_array('Validate target size in current zone'), dynamic([])),
        iff(ResourceKind == 'VM' and EphemeralOS, pack_array('Ephemeral OS disk - plan redeployment'), dynamic([])),
        iff(ResourceKind == 'VM' and Priority =~ 'Spot', pack_array('Spot workload - validate replacement capacity'), dynamic([])),
        iff(ResourceKind == 'VMSS' and GrowthGap > 0, pack_array(strcat('Autoscale growth gap: ', tostring(GrowthGap))), dynamic([])),
        iff(ResourceKind == 'VMSS' and isnotempty(Zones), pack_array('Validate target size in every configured zone'), dynamic([])),
        iff(ResourceKind == 'VMSS' and OrchestrationMode =~ 'Uniform', pack_array('Coordinate model and instance upgrade'), dynamic([]))
      ), ' | '),
    RiskRank = case(isempty(Series), 3, ResourceKind == 'VMSS' and GrowthGap > 0, 0, RetirementDate < datetime(2029-01-01), 1, 2),
    Resource = name,
    Location = location,
    ResourceId = id,
    ResourceGroup = resourceGroup,
    SubscriptionId = subscriptionId
parameters.description: Shared VM and VMSS inventory query used by workbook visualizations.

content.json: Existing VMs keep running, but no new quota is approved for these series. v1/v2 retire in 2028; Dv3, Dsv3, Ev3 and Esv3 on 15 Nov 2029. v4 is no longer restricted.

content.query:
{ComputeInventoryQuery}
| extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| extend _regions = dynamic([{Regions}])
| where array_length(_regions) == 0 or set_has_element(_regions, '*') or set_has_element(_regions, location)
| extend _affected = isnotempty(Series)
| summarize
    AffectedInstances = sumif(InstanceCount, _affected),
    StandaloneVMs = countif(_affected and ResourceKind == 'VM'),
    ScaleSets = countif(_affected and ResourceKind == 'VMSS'),
    GrowthAtRisk = sum(GrowthGap),
    V1V2Increase = sumif(InstanceCount, PriceChangePct == 25),
    RegionalIncrease = sumif(InstanceCount, PriceChangePct > 0 and PriceChangePct < 25),
    V3Retiring = sumif(InstanceCount, Series in ('Dv3','Dsv3','Ev3','Esv3')),
    AffectedSubscriptions = dcountif(SubscriptionId, _affected),
    Regions = dcountif(Location, _affected)
| extend MetricRows = pack_array(
    strcat('1|Affected VM instances|', tostring(AffectedInstances)),
    strcat('2|Standalone VMs|', tostring(StandaloneVMs)),
    strcat('3|VM scale sets|', tostring(ScaleSets)),
    strcat('4|Autoscale growth at risk|', tostring(GrowthAtRisk)),
    strcat('5|v1/v2 instances (+25%)|', tostring(V1V2Increase)),
    strcat('6|Regional increase instances|', tostring(RegionalIncrease)),
    strcat('7|v3 instances (retire 2029)|', tostring(V3Retiring)),
    strcat('8|Affected subscriptions|', tostring(AffectedSubscriptions)),
    strcat('9|Affected regions|', tostring(Regions))
  )
| mv-expand MetricRow = MetricRows to typeof(string)
| extend MetricParts = split(MetricRow, '|')
| project
    Rank = toint(MetricParts[0]),
    Metric = tostring(MetricParts[1]),
    Value = tolong(MetricParts[2])
| order by Rank asc

content.json: From 1 Feb 2027, v1/v2 VMs cost 25% more in every region and most other VMs cost 8-17% more in seven regions. Reserved usage keeps its price until the reservation expires.

content.query:
{ComputeInventoryQuery}
| extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| extend _regions = dynamic([{Regions}])
| where array_length(_regions) == 0 or set_has_element(_regions, '*') or set_has_element(_regions, location)
| where isnotempty(VmSize)
| summarize
    Resources = count(),
    Instances = sum(InstanceCount),
    ['VM sizes'] = strcat_array(make_set(VmSize, 20), ', ')
  by ['Feb 2027 price change'] = PriceChange, Generation = SizeVersion, Region = Location, PriceChangePct
| order by Instances desc, PriceChangePct desc
| project-away PriceChangePct
content.title: Price change by generation and region

content.query:
{ComputeInventoryQuery}
| extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
| extend _regions = dynamic([{Regions}])
| where array_length(_regions) == 0 or set_has_element(_regions, '*') or set_has_element(_regions, location)
| where PriceChangePct > 0
| extend _sizeKey = toupper(VmSize)
| extend Option = case(
    isnotempty(RecommendedTarget), RecommendedTarget,
    PriceChangePct < 25 and _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_D[0-9]', 'Dsv7, Ddsv7, Dlsv7 or Dldsv7 (no regional increase)',
    PriceChangePct < 25 and _sizeKey matches regex '^STANDARD_E[0-9]', 'Esv7 or Edsv7 (no regional increase)',
    '')
| project
    Resource,
    ['Feb 2027 price change'] = PriceChange,
    Type = ResourceKind,
    Subscription,
    ['Resource group'] = ResourceGroup,
    Region = Location,
    ['VM size'] = VmSize,
    ['Size version'] = SizeVersion,
    Instances = InstanceCount,
    ['Retirement date'] = RetirementDate,
    ['Modernization option'] = Option,
    ResourceId,
    PriceChangePct
| order by Instances desc, PriceChangePct desc, Resource asc
| project-away PriceChangePct
content.title: Resources with a price increase

content.json: Azure Advisor VM and scale set retirements since 2024; select a row to list affected resources.

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| where iff(strlen(name) == 36, properties.lastUpdated > ago(1d), properties.platformState == 'New')
| where isempty(properties.tracked)
| extend
    ResourceId = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
    ServiceID = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId)
| where isnotempty(ResourceId) and isnotempty(ServiceID)
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
        or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'
    | extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
    | extend _regions = dynamic([{Regions}])
| where array_length(_regions) == 0 or set_has_element(_regions, '*') or set_has_element(_regions, location)
    | project ResourceId = tolower(id)
  ) on ResourceId
| summarize ['# Resources'] = dcount(ResourceId) by ServiceID
| where ['# Resources'] > 0
| order by ['# Resources'] desc

content.query:
advisorresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations'
| where iff(strlen(name) == 36, properties.lastUpdated > ago(1d), properties.platformState == 'New')
| where isempty(properties.tracked)
| extend
    ResourceId = tolower(tostring(properties.resourceMetadata.resourceId)),
    ServiceID = tostring(properties.recommendationTypeId),
    RecommendationState = tostring(properties.platformState)
| where isnotempty(ResourceId)
    and isnotempty(ServiceID)
    and ServiceID == '{SelectedVmRetirementServiceId}'
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
        or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets'
    | extend _rgs = dynamic([{ResourceGroups}])
| where array_length(_rgs) == 0 or set_has_element(_rgs, '*') or set_has_element(_rgs, resourceGroup)
    | extend _regions = dynamic([{Regions}])
| where array_length(_regions) == 0 or set_has_element(_regions, '*') or set_has_element(_regions, location)
    | join kind=leftouter (
    resourcecontainers
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
    | project subscriptionId, Subscription = name
  ) on subscriptionId
    | extend
        ResourceId = tolower(id),
        ResourceKind = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'VM', 'VMSS'),
        VmSize = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), tostring(sku.name)),
        Capacity = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 1, coalesce(toint(sku.capacity), 0))
    | project
        ResourceId,
        Resource = name,
        Type = ResourceKind,
        ['Current size'] = VmSize,
        Capacity,
        Subscription,
        ['Resource group'] = resourceGroup,
        Region = location,
        Tags = tostring(tags)
  ) on ResourceId
| project
    Resource,
    Subscription,
    ['Resource group'],
    Type,
    ['Current size'],
    Capacity,
    Region,
    ['Recommendation state'] = RecommendationState,
    ResourceId,
    Tags
| distinct Resource, Subscription, ['Resource group'], Type, ['Current size'], Capacity, Region, ['Recommendation state'], ResourceId, Tags
| order by Capacity desc, Resource asc

content.query:
servicehealthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/events'
| extend
    EventType = tostring(properties.EventType),
    EventSubType = tostring(properties.EventSubType),
    Status = tostring(properties.Status),
    Title = tostring(properties.Title),
    TrackingId = tostring(properties.TrackingId),
    SummaryHtml = tostring(properties.Summary),
    EventDate = todatetime(tolong(properties.ImpactMitigationTime))
| where EventType == 'HealthAdvisory'
| extend NoticeText = tolower(strcat(Title, ' ', SummaryHtml))
| where NoticeText contains 'previous-generation'
    or NoticeText contains 'previous generation'
    or NoticeText contains 'capacity growth restriction'
    or NoticeText contains 'v1-v4'
    or NoticeText contains 'dsv3'
    or NoticeText contains 'esv3'
    or (NoticeText contains 'virtual machine' and (NoticeText contains 'end of life' or NoticeText contains 'pric'))
| extend Summary = trim(' ', replace_regex(SummaryHtml, '<[^>]+>', ' '))
| project
    ['Tracking ID'] = TrackingId,
    Subscription = subscriptionId,
    Status,
    Title,
    Summary,
    ['Advisory date'] = EventDate
| order by ['Advisory date'] desc
content.title: VM lifecycle and capacity advisories
content.noDataMessage: No matching advisory is retained in Resource Graph. This does not mean that no VMs are affected.

content.json:
## About the data

| Data | Source |
| --- | --- |
| VM and VMSS size, region, zone and capacity | `microsoft.compute/virtualmachines`, `microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets` |
| Autoscale minimum and maximum | `microsoft.insights/autoscalesettings` |
| Retirement metadata and impact | `providers/Microsoft.Advisor/metadata`, `advisorresources` |
| Advisories | `ServiceHealthResources` |
| Feb 2027 price change | VM size and region, from Microsoft's announced lists |

* Capacity limitation isn't a shutdown notice: VMs keep running until their retirement date. The v4 restrictions were lifted.
* Price rules: v1/v2 +25% in every region. Other series: North Europe +17%, France Central/South +11%, West Europe and Norway East/West +9%, Southeast Asia +8%. Dsv7, Ddsv7, Dlsv7, Dldsv7, Esv7 and Edsv7 are excluded; sovereign clouds are exempt.
* Reservations, savings plans and negotiated prices aren't read. Storage price changes aren't covered.
* **VM SKU retirements** can also include image, extension and platform-feature retirements.
* The workbook can't guarantee quota or capacity. Target families are directional.
* Compute without a VM or VMSS resource, such as Azure Batch pools, isn't covered.

**Affected series:** F, Fs, Fsv2; D, Ds, Dv2, Dsv2, Dv3, Dsv3; B, Bs, Av2, Amv2; Ev3, Esv3; G, Gs; Ls, Lsv2.
